title: The Problem: A Saved Entry Can't Be Edited

blocks.content: Course: Build your First Web App with React
The Problem: A Saved Entry Can't Be Edited
Right now users can add and delete entries. But they cannot fix a typo or update what they wrote.
So adding an Edit button is a no-brainer. The whole process may look something like this:

items: You click Edit on a card.
Then, you change the title or content.
The updated text must then replace the old entry in the state.

blocks.content: Next, let's get an overview of how you'll edit your entry.
